name: Cybersecurity Rookie
tagline: Start from zero: how computers, networks, the web, Linux and Windows work, before touching security.
best: Complete beginners and career changers. No experience needed.
needs: Nothing. This is the first path.
align: Builds the base for CompTIA ITF+ and Network+ topics (guide only)

mods.title: Welcome to Cybersecurity
mods.topics: What cybersecurity is, red, blue and purple teams, job roles, famous breaches, ethics and the law, how to study.
mods.stage: Stage 1: How computers and networks work

mods.title: How Computers Work
mods.topics: Hardware (CPU, RAM, storage), operating systems, binary, hex and ASCII, files and processes, virtual machines.
mods.stage: Stage 1: How computers and networks work

mods.title: Networking Fundamentals
mods.topics: IP and MAC addresses, OSI and TCP/IP models, TCP vs UDP, ports, DNS, DHCP, NAT, routers and switches, Wi-Fi, ping and traceroute.
mods.stage: Stage 1: How computers and networks work

mods.title: How the Web Works
mods.topics: URLs, HTTP requests and responses, methods and status codes, cookies and sessions, HTML, CSS and JavaScript basics, APIs and JSON, databases and SQL basics.
mods.stage: Stage 2: The web and your first operating system

mods.title: Linux I: Meet the Terminal
mods.topics: What Linux is, the shell and prompt, pwd, ls and cd, absolute and relative paths, man pages.
mods.stage: Stage 2: The web and your first operating system

mods.title: Linux II: Files and Folders
mods.topics: mkdir, touch, cp, mv, rm, cat, less, head, tail, wildcards, hidden files and find.
mods.stage: Stage 2: The web and your first operating system

mods.title: Linux III: Users and Permissions
mods.topics: Users and groups, reading ls -l, chmod, chown, sudo and least privilege.
mods.stage: Stage 2: The web and your first operating system

mods.title: Linux IV: Pipes, Processes and Network
mods.topics: grep, pipes and redirects, ps, top and kill, apt updates, ip, ping and ss.
mods.stage: Stage 2: The web and your first operating system

mods.title: Windows Fundamentals
mods.topics: File system, users and groups, UAC, the registry, services, Task Manager, cmd and PowerShell basics, Active Directory intro, Defender and firewall.
mods.stage: Stage 3: Windows, scripting and security basics

mods.title: Scripting Basics
mods.topics: Bash and Python basics: variables, conditions, loops, functions, reading files, regex, automating small tasks.
mods.stage: Stage 3: Windows, scripting and security basics

mods.title: Security Foundations
mods.topics: CIA triad, threats, vulnerabilities and risk, attack surface, defense in depth, least privilege, security policies.
mods.stage: Stage 3: Windows, scripting and security basics

name: Security Core
tagline: The core of cybersecurity: principles, threats, cryptography, access control, web and network security, and a first look at defense and offense.
best: Anyone who finished Pre-Security, or IT people new to security.
align: Covers CompTIA Security+ domains at concept level (guide only)

mods.title: Principles and Frameworks
mods.topics: CIA and AAA, non-repudiation, zero trust intro, cyber kill chain, MITRE ATT&CK intro, NIST CSF, ISO 27001 and CIS Controls overview.

mods.title: The Threat Landscape
mods.topics: Threat actors and motives, common attack types, malware families (viruses, worms, trojans, ransomware, spyware, RATs, botnets), real incident case studies.

mods.title: Social Engineering and Phishing
mods.topics: Phishing, smishing, vishing, pretexting, business email compromise, spotting fakes, defenses and awareness.

mods.title: Cryptography Basics
mods.topics: Encoding vs encryption vs hashing, symmetric and asymmetric keys, hashing and salting, digital signatures, certificates and PKI, the TLS handshake, password storage.

mods.title: Authentication and Access Control
mods.topics: Passwords and managers, MFA, biometrics, SSO, SAML, OAuth and OIDC basics, RBAC and ABAC, session management.

mods.title: Network Security
mods.topics: Firewalls, IDS and IPS, proxies, VPNs, segmentation and DMZ, Wi-Fi security, MITM, ARP spoofing, DoS and DDoS, secure protocols.

mods.title: Web Application Security
mods.topics: OWASP Top 10 overview, injection, XSS, broken authentication, IDOR, CSRF, misconfiguration, secure headers and cookies.

mods.title: Endpoint and OS Security
mods.topics: Hardening basics, patching, antivirus and EDR, allowlisting, disk encryption, backups (3-2-1), mobile device security.

mods.title: Vulnerability Management
mods.topics: Vulnerability vs exploit, CVE, CWE, CVSS, scanners, the patching process, risk prioritization, bug bounty overview.

mods.title: Defensive Security Intro
mods.topics: Logging and monitoring, SIEM intro, SOC roles, alert triage, threat intelligence intro, incident response lifecycle, forensics intro.

mods.title: Offensive Security Intro
mods.topics: Ethical hacking and rules of engagement, pentest phases, recon and OSINT, scanning concepts, exploitation overview, post-exploitation, reporting.

mods.title: Privacy and Compliance
mods.topics: PII, GDPR and CCPA basics, data classification, DLP, retention, common compliance frameworks.

mods.title: Cloud Security Basics
mods.topics: Cloud models, shared responsibility, cloud IAM, common misconfigurations, storage exposure, containers 101.

mods.title: Careers and Next Steps
mods.topics: Certification map, building a portfolio, CTFs and practice platforms, choosing a specialization.

mods.title: Capstone Review
mods.topics: Mixed review across all modules and a final exam with a completion certificate.

name: Cyber Analyst (SOC)
tagline: Blue team path: detect, investigate and respond to attacks like a SOC analyst, from log reading to threat hunting.
best: People aiming at SOC analyst, incident responder, threat hunter or DFIR roles.
needs: Security 101, especially Defensive Security Intro and Network Security.
align: Overlaps CompTIA CySA+ and Security Blue Team BTL1 topics (guide only)

mods.title: SOC Fundamentals
mods.topics: SOC structure and tiers, tools, alert lifecycle, SLAs, playbooks, shift handoffs, metrics such as MTTD and MTTR.

mods.title: Log Analysis Essentials
mods.topics: Log types and formats (syslog, JSON, CEF), parsing, correlation, timelines, regex for logs.

mods.title: Windows Event Logs and Sysmon
mods.topics: Key event IDs, logon types, process creation, PowerShell logging, persistence artifacts.

mods.title: Linux and Web Server Logs
mods.topics: auth.log, syslog, auditd, web access logs, spotting brute force and scanning.

mods.title: SIEM Fundamentals
mods.topics: SIEM architecture, ingestion and normalization, query concepts (SPL, KQL), dashboards, alerts, tuning false positives.

mods.title: Network Traffic Analysis
mods.topics: Packet basics, Wireshark, PCAP triage, DNS, HTTP and SMB analysis, Zeek and Suricata, beaconing and exfiltration patterns.

mods.title: Endpoint Detection and Response
mods.topics: EDR concepts, process trees, living-off-the-land binaries, EDR triage, host isolation.

mods.title: Phishing and Email Analysis
mods.topics: Email headers, SPF, DKIM and DMARC, URL and attachment analysis, sandboxing, user report workflow.

mods.title: Threat Intelligence
mods.topics: Intel types, IOCs vs TTPs, STIX and TAXII, MISP, Diamond model, intel-driven defense, OSINT for analysts.

mods.title: MITRE ATT&CK for Defenders
mods.topics: Tactics and techniques, mapping detections, coverage gaps, ATT&CK Navigator.

mods.title: Malware Triage
mods.topics: File hashes and strings, sandbox reports, behavior, VirusTotal, common families, safe handling.

mods.title: Incident Response
mods.topics: IR lifecycle, containment, eradication, recovery, evidence handling, communication, post-incident review, playbooks.

mods.title: Digital Forensics Essentials
mods.topics: Disk and memory forensics intro, timelines, artifacts, chain of custody, tool concepts (Autopsy, Volatility).

mods.title: Detection Engineering
mods.topics: Sigma, YARA, Snort and Suricata rules, detection logic, testing, tuning, detection as code.

mods.title: Threat Hunting
mods.topics: Hypotheses, data sources, hunt methods, baselining, anomaly detection, hunt reports.

mods.title: Cloud and Identity Detection
mods.topics: Cloud logs (CloudTrail, Entra ID sign-ins), password spraying, token theft, SaaS alerts.

mods.title: SOC Reporting and Communication
mods.topics: Incident reports, escalation, executive summaries, ticketing.

mods.title: Capstone: Investigate an Incident
mods.topics: A simulated alert queue and an end-to-end case using logs, a PCAP and an email.

name: Penetration Testing
tagline: Red team path: think like an attacker, in authorized and legal scenarios, from recon to reporting.
best: People aiming at penetration tester, red team or application security roles.
needs: Security 101 (Offensive Security Intro), plus Linux and Networking.
align: Overlaps CompTIA PenTest+, eJPT and PNPT topics (guide only)

mods.title: Methodology, Scope and Law
mods.topics: Test phases (PTES, OWASP WSTG, NIST SP 800-115), scoping, rules of engagement, authorization, ethics, reporting overview.

mods.title: Reconnaissance and OSINT
mods.topics: Passive vs active recon, DNS enumeration, WHOIS, subdomain discovery, search dorking, metadata, Shodan and Censys.

mods.title: Scanning and Enumeration
mods.topics: Nmap (host discovery, scan types, versions, scripts), banner grabbing, enumerating SMB, FTP, SSH, SNMP and HTTP.

mods.title: Vulnerability Assessment
mods.topics: Scanner concepts (Nessus, OpenVAS), manual verification, prioritization, handling false positives.

mods.title: Web App Pentesting I
mods.topics: Proxy tools (Burp, ZAP), mapping the app, authentication and session testing, access control and IDOR, input validation.

mods.title: Web App Pentesting II
mods.topics: SQL injection, XSS, CSRF, SSRF, file upload flaws, XXE, deserialization, path traversal, command injection, business logic flaws.

mods.title: API and Mobile Testing
mods.topics: REST and GraphQL testing, JWT issues, broken object level authorization, rate limiting, Android basics and OWASP MASVS.

mods.title: Network Pentesting
mods.topics: Service exploitation concepts, the Metasploit framework, credential attacks, sniffing and MITM, safe exploitation practice.

mods.title: Password and Hash Cracking
mods.topics: Hash types, Hashcat and John concepts, wordlists and rules, salting, pass-the-hash overview.

mods.title: Linux Privilege Escalation
mods.topics: Enumeration, SUID, sudo misconfigurations, cron jobs, capabilities, kernel exploits at concept level.

mods.title: Windows Privilege Escalation
mods.topics: Services, tokens, registry, unquoted paths, UAC bypass concepts, credential hunting.

mods.title: Active Directory Attacks
mods.topics: AD concepts, Kerberos and NTLM, enumeration with BloodHound, Kerberoasting, AS-REP roasting, pass-the-ticket, lateral movement, defenses.

mods.title: Post-Exploitation and Pivoting
mods.topics: Tunneling and port forwarding, lateral movement, persistence concepts, data exfiltration, cleanup.

mods.title: Wireless and Physical Security
mods.topics: WPA attack overview, rogue access points, physical access testing, badge cloning concepts.

mods.title: Social Engineering Engagements
mods.topics: Authorized phishing campaigns, pretexting, vishing, measuring awareness.

mods.title: Cloud Pentesting
mods.topics: Cloud IAM abuse, storage misconfigurations, metadata service, serverless and container escapes at concept level.

mods.title: Binary Exploitation Basics
mods.topics: Memory layout, stack and buffer overflows, shellcode concept, ASLR and DEP, reverse engineering intro.

mods.title: Red Team Fundamentals
mods.topics: Adversary emulation, C2 concepts, OPSEC, evasion at concept level, purple teaming.

mods.title: Reporting and Communication
mods.topics: Writing findings, risk rating, remediation advice, executive summaries, retesting.

mods.title: Capstone: Full Engagement
mods.topics: A guided assessment from scope to final report.

name: Security Engineering
tagline: Build security in: architecture, hardening, identity, cloud, DevSecOps, automation and governance.
best: Sysadmins and developers moving into security engineering or DevSecOps.
needs: Security 101, plus Scripting Basics from Pre-Security.
align: Overlaps CISSP, AWS Security Specialty and CKS topics (guide only)

mods.title: Secure Architecture and Threat Modeling
mods.topics: STRIDE, PASTA, attack trees, trust boundaries, secure design patterns, zero trust, defense in depth.

mods.title: System Hardening
mods.topics: CIS benchmarks, Linux and Windows hardening, patch management, configuration management, baselines.

mods.title: Identity and Access Engineering
mods.topics: Directory services, SSO and federation (SAML, OIDC), PAM, MFA rollout, service accounts, secrets.

mods.title: Network Security Engineering
mods.topics: Firewall design, segmentation and microsegmentation, VPN and ZTNA, WAF, DNS security, DDoS defense, NAC.

mods.title: Cryptography in Practice
mods.topics: TLS configuration, certificate lifecycle, KMS and HSM, key rotation, secrets management, common implementation mistakes.

mods.title: Application Security
mods.topics: Secure coding practices, secure SDLC, code review, SAST, DAST, SCA, dependency risk, security champions.

mods.title: DevSecOps and CI/CD Security
mods.topics: Pipeline threats, secrets in repos, artifact signing, SBOM, supply chain security (SLSA), policy as code.

mods.title: Cloud Security Engineering
mods.topics: IAM design, network controls, encryption, logging, CSPM, landing zones, AWS, Azure and GCP patterns.

mods.title: Container and Kubernetes Security
mods.topics: Image scanning, runtime security, RBAC, network policies, pod security, secrets handling.

mods.title: Infrastructure as Code Security
mods.topics: Terraform and CloudFormation scanning, drift, guardrails, policy as code.

mods.title: Logging and Monitoring Architecture
mods.topics: Log pipelines, SIEM engineering, retention, alert design, metrics.

mods.title: Vulnerability and Patch Programs
mods.topics: Asset inventory, scan cadence, risk-based prioritization (EPSS, KEV), SLAs, exceptions.

mods.title: Endpoint and Email Security
mods.topics: EDR rollout, MDM, email gateways, DMARC rollout, browser security.

mods.title: Security Automation and Scripting
mods.topics: Python and Bash for security, working with APIs, SOAR, automating triage and response, infrastructure tests.

mods.title: Incident Readiness and Resilience
mods.topics: IR plans, tabletop exercises, backups and disaster recovery, business continuity, purple team exercises.

mods.title: GRC for Engineers
mods.topics: Risk assessment, control mapping, ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST SP 800-53, audits and evidence collection.

mods.title: Security Metrics and Program Management
mods.topics: KPIs, roadmaps, budgets, communicating with leadership.

mods.title: Capstone: Secure a Company
mods.topics: A design review and hardening plan for a fictional company.

name: AI Security
tagline: Understand how AI systems work, how they are attacked and defended, and how to use AI safely in security work.
best: Security people, developers and ML engineers working on AI products.
needs: Security 101. No data science background needed.
align: Aligned with OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF and ISO 42001

mods.title: AI and ML Foundations
mods.topics: ML concepts, training vs inference, neural networks intro, data pipelines, evaluation, common model types.

mods.title: How LLMs Work
mods.topics: Tokens, embeddings, transformers (intuitive), context windows, prompting, RAG, fine-tuning, agents and tools.

mods.title: Threats to AI Systems
mods.topics: AI attack surface, threat modeling for AI, MITRE ATLAS, NIST adversarial ML taxonomy.

mods.title: Prompt Injection and Jailbreaks
mods.topics: Direct and indirect injection, jailbreak patterns, guardrails, defenses, how to evaluate them.

mods.title: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Apps
mods.topics: Insecure output handling, sensitive information disclosure, excessive agency, supply chain, and the rest of the list.

mods.title: Data and Model Attacks
mods.topics: Data poisoning, backdoors, model extraction, membership inference, model inversion, adversarial examples.

mods.title: Securing the ML Pipeline
mods.topics: Data provenance, model signing, registries, model supply chain (unsafe serialization), access control, drift monitoring.

mods.title: Securing AI Agents and Tool Use
mods.topics: Least privilege for agents, tool permissions, sandboxing, connector and MCP risks, human in the loop, secrets.

mods.title: AI Red Teaming
mods.topics: Scoping, test plans, harm categories, automated probing tools, safety evaluations, reporting.

mods.title: AI Privacy and Data Protection
mods.topics: Training data privacy, PII leakage, differential privacy intro, federated learning, regulations.

mods.title: AI Governance, Risk and Compliance
mods.topics: NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, EU AI Act, model cards, responsible AI, AI incident handling.

mods.title: AI for Defenders
mods.topics: AI in the SOC (triage, summaries, detection), phishing detection, anomaly detection, hallucination risks, judging AI security tools.

mods.title: AI-Enabled Threats
mods.topics: Deepfakes, voice cloning, AI-written phishing, automated attacks, detection and defenses.

mods.title: Capstone: Assess an AI App
mods.topics: A guided security review of a fictional LLM-powered app.
